title: Variable-power coefficient reduction and its actual unit triangle
statement: Let l be a prime and T any scheme. Let r be any Reduction T (Rrings l T), as in [def-sp-tower-class-reduction, def-sp-tower-class-coefficients], and let p:powerUnits l T → units T have components Scheme.proEtaleUnitsPower T (l^(n+1)) at every n, with the systems of [def-sp-tower-class-systems]. There exists a morphism δ making single(powerUnits) --single(p)--> single(units) --η--> r.forget.F.mapDerivedCategory(r.derived(single(units))) --δ--> single(powerUnits)[1] a distinguished triangle in the ordinary derived category of whole abelian towers. Here η is the actual unit of r.derivedAdjunction. No invertibility of l on T, no Kummer short exact sequence, no roots object, and no module-action or cohomology comparison is assumed or concluded.

source.place: clause (2), coefficient resolution and unit; parent lem-sfb-kummer-reduction-unit proof step 1

proof.text: Use the constructed transition functor and multiplication transformation. Resolve the constant units complex by the torsion-free counit-computing resolution. Its twisted resolution map is a quasi-isomorphism because twisting leaves every evaluated complex unchanged.

Apply the ordinary cokernel lemma to every degree of the resolution. Its multiplication map is monic at every level by the resolution properties, so the cokernel sequences are short exact. Assemble these into a short exact sequence of cochain complexes.

The short exact cochain sequence gives its standard distinguished triangle. Specialize r.model.transpose to the identity of the ordinary extended complex. This identifies its actual derived unit followed by the counit and exact-forgetting comparison with the localized ordinary unit. Invert the counit and compose with the resolution quasi-isomorphism; naturality of the derived unit then supplies the second square of the triangle isomorphism.

The twisted constant units complex identifies with single(powerUnits). At degree zero the multiplication transformation is l^(n+1) times the identity, hence is exactly p by hp and natural-transformation extensionality. Naturality of multiplication at the resolution map gives the first square. The explicit connecting arrow e3.inv ≫ delta_SES ≫ shift(e1.hom) gives the last square. Transport distinguishedness along this three-vertex isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: ordinary quotient and resolution steps isolated; transition functor, short-exact assembly and actual-unit transport proved in Lean

lean.statement:
theorem powerSystem_reduction_triangle (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (r : Reduction T (Rrings l T)) (p : powerUnits l T ⟶ units T)
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, p.app (op n) = Scheme.proEtaleUnitsPower T (l ^ (n + 1))) :
    ∃ δ, Triangle.mk ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).map p)
      (r.derivedAdjunction.unit.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (units T)))
      δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (Ab T))
